speaker: (the tapster)
text: Master, it was this morning, and the street is full of the telling of it—

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Not in my kitchen. You may stand on the mat. You may not bring the manner of it up the stair.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: I only came because a man should hear it from a mouth, and not from a shout in a lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you have come, and I have heard that there is a telling. I do not want the rest of it over the bread.

speaker: (the waterman)
text: I am not his telling. I came up from the door because what I had is not what he has, and somebody in the house ought to know they differ.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then neither of you will finish it here. I am a Christian woman with a pot on the fire. Mark me. The manner stays outside.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I heard a name in the lane, mistress, on my way back from the loom. I came indoors. I will not say the name twice. That is all I carried up.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you were right, Master Verbeke. A name is enough to spoil a dinner, and the way of it would spoil the house. Alse is not to be sent to the door for a better version.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not sending anyone. I am not going myself. I will not pay a penny to go and stand where it was done. I was never going.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: Three of us have it, if you count the neighbour Mistress will not quote, and no two of us have the same end to it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have a neighbour's account. I am not your third speech. You will not draw it out of me with a bowl in my hands, nor with the bowl set down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three mouths, then, and they will not match. I can hear that without borrowing any man's eyes. Hearing a thing is not the same as having stood there.

speaker: (the waterman)
text: I did not say you stood there, master. I said the stories do not agree. I can leave the disagreement on the mat and go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. I will have the disagreement, since it is already in the house. I will not have the picture. Mistress Ansell is right about her kitchen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am right about the stair as well. You two will go down it. Master Shakespeare is not at home to a crowd, and the company may play The Shrew this afternoon without him. He is not putting his hat on.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am at my loom after this. Sunday the loom was still. Today it is not. I have nothing more for the stair, and I do not want it.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: Then I have done what a tapster does, which is to arrive too early with too much. I will not force the rest past her.

speaker: (the waterman)
text: Nor I. If you want my version you know the stair I row from. I am not shouting it up a lodging.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not want your version on the stair, and I am not coming down to the water for it. Three is already more than a man needs if he was never going.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Down, both. There is pottage at four, Master Shakespeare, and it will be the same pottage as any Friday. Threepence if you sit. The news is not a fourth dish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. Put me down for the threepence. And do not look at me as if I might slip out after. I have said I was never going. I am saying it while they can still hear me.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will eat at my own hour. Thank you, mistress. The lane can keep the rest of its noise. I have silk that will not wait on a story.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Alse will bar nothing, because there is nothing to bar if the door is simply shut. Shut it behind you.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: God give you a quiet house, then. I did not come to make it loud.

speaker: (the waterman)
text: Nor I. The river is loud enough. I am sorry for the hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You came. That was the errand. The rest of it is not this room's. Mistress, I will be at the table at four, and I will not be looking at a bill between now and then.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There is no bill in this house that concerns you today. Eat when it is hot. If you burn a candle over an empty page, that candle is yours, and I shall count it with the others at night.
